nodes.summary: Let $J(X)$ be Jacobi's cube series. If a natural number $b$ is not of the form $t(t+1)/2$ for any natural number $t$, then the coefficient of $X^b$ in $J(X)$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Vanishing coefficients of Jacobi's cube series

nodes.summary: Let $J(X)$ be Jacobi's cube series. For every natural number $t$, the coefficient of $X^{t(t+1)/2}$ in $J(X)$ is $(-1)^t (2t+1)$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of Jacobi's cube series at triangular numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $r < p$ be a natural number, and let $E(X) = \sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} (-1)^k X^{k(3k-1)/2}$ be Euler's pentagonal series in $\mathbb{Z}[[X]]$. If $p$ divides the coefficient of $X^{pm+r}$ in $E(X)^{p-1}$ for every natural number $m$, then $p$ divides the number of partitions of $pm + r$ for every natural number $m$.
nodes.title: Partition congruences from a power of Euler's series

nodes.summary: Jacobi's cube series is the formal power series $J(X) = \sum_{t \ge 0} (-1)^t (2t+1) X^{t(t+1)/2}$ in $\mathbb{Z}[[X]]$: for each natural number $t$ its coefficient at the triangular number $t(t+1)/2$ is $(-1)^t (2t+1)$, and all its other coefficients are $0$.
nodes.title: Jacobi's cube series

nodes.summary: Let $E(X) = \sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} (-1)^k X^{k(3k-1)/2}$ be Euler's pentagonal series and $J(X) = \sum_{t \ge 0} (-1)^t (2t+1) X^{t(t+1)/2}$ Jacobi's cube series, both in $\mathbb{Z}[[X]]$. Then $E(X)^3 = J(X)$.
nodes.title: Jacobi's cube identity

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the number of partitions of $11m + 6$ is divisible by $11$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's congruence modulo 11

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the number of partitions of $5m + 4$ is divisible by $5$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's congruence modulo 5

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the number of partitions of $7m + 5$ is divisible by $7$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's congruence modulo 7

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
